content.short: Lava Network connects dapps to a decentralized RPC network for fast, reliable, and private access.
content.description: Lava routes RPC relays through a decentralized network of leading providers, rewarding them based on the quality of service they deliver. This design reduces costs for developers, delivers faster responses, improves reliability, and enhances privacy for user queries. By coordinating nodes and client apps, Lava helps establish an open standard for blockchain access, already supporting 15+ chains and sustained by a broad community of open-source contributors who collaborate to improve the platform.
